Mega Menu Animation

Web,Fintech,Cinematic·by @gabriell_lab·2026-08-30·inspora page·original post

What it is

Fintech marketing site ('Grain') nav with a mega menu: hovering Products drops a wide panel with a 2-column feature link list and a sunset image card, over a blurred golden-hour hero; panel opens with fade+settle and closes cleanly.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Closed: slim nav (Grain wordmark; Products/Resources/Compliance with carets) over a blurred warm landscape hero with 'Built for Modern Payments' headline.
15-30%
Products hover: mega panel appears below nav - white/translucent card spanning content width, opacity 0->1, translateY -8px->0 with ease-out.
30-70%
Panel open: left column feature links with icons (Stablecoin Checkout, Virtual Accounts, Cross-Border Transfers), right column secondary links (Links, Invoicing, Connect), far-right sunset image card with caption; individual items highlight on hover.
70-90%
Pointer leaves: panel fades and lifts back out (~200ms), nav carets rotate back.
90-100%
Closed state restored.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a fintech marketing nav where hovering "Products" drops a wide mega menu (2 link columns + sunset image card) over a blurred golden-hour hero. It must open with a soft settle and close cleanly, with intent delays so it never flickers.

## Stack
React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Framer Motion (AnimatePresence for the panel exit). Animate transform and opacity only.

## Scene
Transparent nav bar over a full-bleed blurred warm landscape hero with headline "Built for Modern Payments". Bar: wordmark left; items Products / Resources / Compliance, each with a 12px caret. Panel: full content width below the bar, translucent white (white/85, backdrop-blur 12px), radius 16, border black/5, shadow 0 24px 48px black/12. Interior 3-column grid: col 1 - three feature links (32px icon tile, semibold title, 2-line zinc-500 description); col 2 - three plain links with arrow icons; col 3 - 4:3 sunset image card with caption.

## Motion spec
Pattern: hover-intent reveal.
- Open trigger: hover or focus on Products after a 150ms intent delay. Close grace: 300ms before closing when the pointer leaves (covers diagonal moves into the panel).
- Panel enter: opacity 0 -> 1, y -8 -> 0, 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
- Caret: rotate 0 -> 180deg, 200ms ease-out, synced with the panel.
- Panel exit: opacity 1 -> 0, y 0 -> -4, 180ms ease-in (exit ~30% faster than enter).
- Link rows: hover background zinc-950/4 appears instantly (no transition on the color), radius 8.
- Interior content does not stagger in - it is fully formed the moment the panel fades in.

## Calibration
- Amplitude is small on purpose: 8px of travel, no scale, no bounce.
- Open 250ms / close 180ms. Anything slower makes the nav feel sticky; anything faster feels abrupt.
- The blurred hero stays static; only the panel and caret move.

## Reduced motion
Panel appears/disappears with opacity only, 150ms. Caret rotation stays (it is positional, not decorative).

## Don't miss
- The 150ms open delay and 300ms close grace are the whole interaction - without them diagonal pointer paths flicker the panel.
- The panel is translucent with backdrop blur, not solid white; the hero bleeds through faintly.
- Carets rotate on the item that owns the open panel only.
